effects.name: Armor Broken
effects.player: Defence counts as nought; a defence already below nought is left as it is.
effects.enemy: The same: its defence counts as nought, so every shot lands in full.

effects.name: Armored
effects.player: Defence counts half again, rounded down. Armor Broken cancels it.
effects.enemy: The same: its defence counts half again.

effects.name: Berserk
effects.player: Attacks a quarter faster - the rate, not the DEX stat. Dazed cancels it.
effects.enemy: Only a sign that it is boosted.

effects.name: Bleeding
effects.player: Loses twenty life a second and stops regenerating; cannot kill.
effects.enemy: Loses life every second, the figure set by the shot that caused it (twenty if it says none).

effects.name: Blind
effects.player: The screen goes almost black.

effects.name: Blizzard
effects.player: The Ice Citadel's frostbite: a slow that grows, then drains life, unless you stay near warmth.

effects.name: Confused
effects.player: Directions and rotation are swapped.
effects.enemy: Only a sign that its AI is disrupted.

inflictedBy.id: enemy:Retro Jon Bilgewater the Pirate King

effects.name: Curse
effects.player: Takes a quarter more damage, counted after armour.
effects.enemy: Takes a quarter more damage, counted after armour.

inflictedBy.id: enemy:Haunted Cemetery Gates Small White Ghost

effects.name: Damaging
effects.player: Weapon damage a quarter higher - the damage, not the ATT stat. Weak cancels it.
effects.enemy: Its shots ignore armour.

effects.name: Darkness
effects.player: Sight shrinks to a small circle around you.

effects.name: Dazed
effects.player: Fires as if DEX were nought.
effects.enemy: Fires half its shots a volley, never fewer than one.
immune: enemy:Demon Brute Brawler#Tavern Demon Brawler Brute
enemy:Demon Mage Brawler#Tavern Demon Brawler Mage

effects.name: Drought
effects.player: No consumable can be used.

effects.name: Drunk
effects.player: The screen blurs or warps.

effects.name: Energized
effects.player: Ten more magic a second.
effects.enemy: Only a sign that it is empowered.

effects.name: Exposed
effects.player: Defence counts twenty lower, and may go below nought.
effects.enemy: Defence counts twenty lower and may go below nought, so even shots that ignore armour, or hit an Armor Broken target, do twenty more.

effects.name: Hallucinating
effects.player: Things on screen are drawn as other things.

grants.id: item:Legacy Seal of the Enchanted Forest

effects.name: Healing
effects.player: Life comes back faster, twenty a second unless the source says otherwise; the strongest of several wins. Sick cancels it.

effects.name: Hex
effects.player: Not a player status.
effects.enemy: A mark the newer orbs pile up with each hit; enough of it set off turns into Petrify.

effects.name: Hexed
effects.player: Your sprite is replaced by a random pet's.

effects.name: In Combat
effects.player: Held in combat, whatever the damage taken.

inflictedBy.id: enemy:Dark Memory of Sprites#NMR Minion Adept Sprite

effects.name: Inspired
effects.player: Shots fly a quarter further (the Lullaby shortens them instead).
effects.enemy: No effect.

effects.name: Invincible
effects.player: Cannot be hit at all: shots pass through. Given briefly on arriving somewhere.
effects.enemy: Cannot be hit; used between boss phases.

inflictedBy.id: enemy:Dark Memory of Sprites#NMR Minion Adept Sprite

effects.name: Invisible
effects.player: Enemies cannot aim at you, though their shots still hurt. Quiet ends it.

effects.name: Invulnerable
effects.player: Takes no damage from attacks, though still from hazards and statuses.
effects.enemy: Takes no damage; used between boss phases.

inflictedBy.id: enemy:Dark Memory of Sprites#NMR Minion Adept Sprite

effects.name: Lethal Strike
effects.player: After leaving a cloak's sneak, two extra shots a volley for a short while.

effects.name: Paralyzed
effects.player: Cannot move.
effects.enemy: Cannot move.
